Going to see if i can improve R-squared for my sites:
Original: VPD, Tair, SW_rad, cumulative cwd 7 day
1) VPD, Tair, SW_rad, BOUNDED cumulative cwd 7 day (running total floors at 7 days)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

set.seed(42)

standardise_train_test <- function(train_df, test_df, predictors) {
  train_means <- colMeans(train_df[predictors], na.rm = TRUE)
  train_sds   <- apply(train_df[predictors], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  train_df[predictors] <- scale(train_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  test_df[predictors]  <- scale(test_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

run_rf_with_without_vpd <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, date)
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = lubridate::year(date),

      # ── Bounded cumulative CWD — running total floored at zero ───────────────
      # Deficit accumulates when PET > ET, resets toward zero on recharge
      # Never goes negative — physically meaningful drought stress index
      cwd_bounded = accumulate(cwd, ~ pmax(.x + .y, 0)),

      # ── 7-day rolling mean of bounded CWD ────────────────────────────────────
      # Mean rather than sum so scale is interpretable (avg daily deficit)
      cumulative_cwd_7day_bounded = rollapply(
        cwd_bounded, width = 7, FUN = mean,
        align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  
  # Only change from original — CWD predictor is now bounded version
  predictors_with    <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day_bounded")
  predictors_without <- c("Tair", "SW_rad",         "cumulative_cwd_7day_bounded")
  
  fit_rf_loyo <- function(predictors, label) {
    
    model_df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, all_of(predictors))
    
    if (nrow(model_df) < 100) {
      message("  Skipping ", label, " at ", site_name, ": insufficient data")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    years <- unique(model_df$year)
    
    all_preds      <- list()
    all_importance <- list()
    
    for (year_i in years) {
      
      train_data <- model_df %>% filter(year != year_i)
      test_data  <- model_df %>% filter(year == year_i)
      
      if (nrow(test_data) < 10 || nrow(train_data) < 50) next
      
      scaled      <- standardise_train_test(train_data, test_data, predictors)
      train_data  <- scaled$train
      test_data   <- scaled$test
      
      mtry_val <- max(2, floor(sqrt(length(predictors))))
      
      formula <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
      
      model <- randomForest(formula, data = train_data,
                            ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val, importance = TRUE)
      
      preds <- predict(model, test_data)
      
      all_preds[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        Observed  = test_data$GPP,
        Predicted = preds,
        year      = year_i
      )
      
      all_importance[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        variable   = rownames(importance(model)),
        importance = importance(model, type = 1)[, 1],
        year       = year_i
      )
    }
    
    results <- bind_rows(all_preds)
    
    if (nrow(results) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    rmse     <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
    rsq      <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
    mean_obs <- mean(results$Observed)
    nse      <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                     sum((results$Observed - mean_obs)^2)
    
    importance_df <- bind_rows(all_importance) %>%
      group_by(variable) %>%
      summarise(importance = mean(importance), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(model = label, site = site_name)
    
    list(
      metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, model = label,
                               RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
      importance  = importance_df,
      predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name, model = label)
    )
  }
  
  with_vpd    <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_with,    "with_VPD")
  without_vpd <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_without, "without_VPD")
  
  if (is.null(with_vpd) || is.null(without_vpd)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    site        = site_name,
    metrics     = bind_rows(with_vpd$metrics,     without_vpd$metrics),
    importance  = bind_rows(with_vpd$importance,  without_vpd$importance),
    predictions = bind_rows(with_vpd$predictions, without_vpd$predictions)
  )
}

# ── Run model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rf_results_vpd <- purrr::map2(
  sites_daily,
  names(sites_daily),
  run_rf_with_without_vpd
)

all_metrics_vpd <- purrr::map_df(rf_results_vpd, ~ .x$metrics)

# ── Compute number of years per site ──────────────────────────────────────────
n_years_df <- purrr::map_df(rf_results_vpd, function(res) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    site    = res$site,
    n_years = length(unique(res$predictions$year))
  )
})

site_meta <- site_meta %>%
  left_join(n_years_df, by = "site")

# ── Prepare plot data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  select(site, R2) %>%
  left_join(
    site_meta %>% select(site, MAP, MAT, MAL, n_years.x),
    by = "site"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MAP, MAT, MAL),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# ── Plot 1: ΔR² from adding VPD ───────────────────────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  mutate(
    site    = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order),
    R2_gain = with_VPD - without_VPD
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2_gain)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "ΔR² from adding VPD",
    y     = "ΔR² (with − without)",
    x     = "Sites (Wet to Dry)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Plot 2: R² with VPD — wet to dry order ────────────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Model R² (with VPD)",
    y     = "R²",
    x     = "Sites (Wet to Dry)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

# ── Plot 3: MAP, MAT, MAL vs R² ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggrepel)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, y = R2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey40",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = site), size = 2.8, colour = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3,
             labeller = labeller(variable = c(
               MAP = "MAP (mm yr⁻¹)",
               MAT = "MAT (°C)",
               MAL = "MAL (m² m⁻²)"
             ))) +
  labs(y = "R² (RF with VPD)", x = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA)
  )

# ── Plot 4: Number of years vs R² ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(plot_data %>% distinct(site, R2, n_years.x), aes(x = n_years.x, y = R2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey40",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = site), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  labs(x = "No. of Years of Observations", y = "R²") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Summary metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
metrics_wide <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  rename(
    R2_with_VPD    = with_VPD,
    R2_without_VPD = without_VPD
  ) %>%
  mutate(delta_R2 = R2_with_VPD - R2_without_VPD)

summary(metrics_wide)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

set.seed(42)

standardise_train_test <- function(train_df, test_df, predictors) {
  train_means <- colMeans(train_df[predictors], na.rm = TRUE)
  train_sds   <- apply(train_df[predictors], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  train_df[predictors] <- scale(train_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  test_df[predictors]  <- scale(test_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

run_rf_with_without_vpd <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, date)
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = lubridate::year(date),

      # ── Bounded cumulative CWD — running total floored at zero ───────────────
      # Deficit accumulates when PET > ET, resets toward zero on recharge
      # Never goes negative — physically meaningful drought stress index
      cwd_bounded = accumulate(cwd, ~ pmax(.x + .y, 0)),

      # ── 7-day rolling mean of bounded CWD ────────────────────────────────────
      # Mean rather than sum so scale is interpretable (avg daily deficit)
      cumulative_cwd_30day_bounded = rollapply(
        cwd_bounded, width = 30, FUN = mean,
        align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  
  # Only change from original — CWD predictor is now bounded version
  predictors_with    <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_30day_bounded")
  predictors_without <- c("Tair", "SW_rad",         "cumulative_cwd_30day_bounded")
  
  fit_rf_loyo <- function(predictors, label) {
    
    model_df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, all_of(predictors))
    
    if (nrow(model_df) < 100) {
      message("  Skipping ", label, " at ", site_name, ": insufficient data")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    years <- unique(model_df$year)
    
    all_preds      <- list()
    all_importance <- list()
    
    for (year_i in years) {
      
      train_data <- model_df %>% filter(year != year_i)
      test_data  <- model_df %>% filter(year == year_i)
      
      if (nrow(test_data) < 10 || nrow(train_data) < 50) next
      
      scaled      <- standardise_train_test(train_data, test_data, predictors)
      train_data  <- scaled$train
      test_data   <- scaled$test
      
      mtry_val <- max(2, floor(sqrt(length(predictors))))
      
      formula <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
      
      model <- randomForest(formula, data = train_data,
                            ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val, importance = TRUE)
      
      preds <- predict(model, test_data)
      
      all_preds[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        Observed  = test_data$GPP,
        Predicted = preds,
        year      = year_i
      )
      
      all_importance[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        variable   = rownames(importance(model)),
        importance = importance(model, type = 1)[, 1],
        year       = year_i
      )
    }
    
    results <- bind_rows(all_preds)
    
    if (nrow(results) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    rmse     <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
    rsq      <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
    mean_obs <- mean(results$Observed)
    nse      <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                     sum((results$Observed - mean_obs)^2)
    
    importance_df <- bind_rows(all_importance) %>%
      group_by(variable) %>%
      summarise(importance = mean(importance), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(model = label, site = site_name)
    
    list(
      metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, model = label,
                               RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
      importance  = importance_df,
      predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name, model = label)
    )
  }
  
  with_vpd    <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_with,    "with_VPD")
  without_vpd <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_without, "without_VPD")
  
  if (is.null(with_vpd) || is.null(without_vpd)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    site        = site_name,
    metrics     = bind_rows(with_vpd$metrics,     without_vpd$metrics),
    importance  = bind_rows(with_vpd$importance,  without_vpd$importance),
    predictions = bind_rows(with_vpd$predictions, without_vpd$predictions)
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)

set.seed(42)

standardise_train_test <- function(train_df, test_df, predictors) {
  train_means <- colMeans(train_df[predictors], na.rm = TRUE)
  train_sds   <- apply(train_df[predictors], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  train_df[predictors] <- scale(train_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  test_df[predictors]  <- scale(test_df[predictors],
                                 center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

run_rf_with_without_vpd <- function(df, site_name) {
  
  # LAI_filled added to drop_na — rows missing LAI will be excluded
  df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, Tair, SW_rad, VPD, cwd, LAI_filled, date)
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    warning(paste("Site", site_name, "has insufficient data"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      year = lubridate::year(date),

      # Unbounded 7-day rolling sum — same as original baseline
      cumulative_cwd_7day = rollapply(
        cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
        align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  
  # LAI_filled added to both predictor sets
  predictors_with    <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day", "LAI_filled")
  predictors_without <- c("Tair", "SW_rad",         "cumulative_cwd_7day", "LAI_filled")
  
  fit_rf_loyo <- function(predictors, label) {
    
    model_df <- df %>% drop_na(GPP, all_of(predictors))
    
    if (nrow(model_df) < 100) {
      message("  Skipping ", label, " at ", site_name, ": insufficient data")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    years <- unique(model_df$year)
    
    all_preds      <- list()
    all_importance <- list()
    
    for (year_i in years) {
      
      train_data <- model_df %>% filter(year != year_i)
      test_data  <- model_df %>% filter(year == year_i)
      
      if (nrow(test_data) < 10 || nrow(train_data) < 50) next
      
      scaled     <- standardise_train_test(train_data, test_data, predictors)
      train_data <- scaled$train
      test_data  <- scaled$test
      
      mtry_val <- max(2, floor(sqrt(length(predictors))))
      
      formula <- as.formula(paste("GPP ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
      
      model <- randomForest(formula, data = train_data,
                            ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val, importance = TRUE)
      
      preds <- predict(model, test_data)
      
      all_preds[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        Observed  = test_data$GPP,
        Predicted = preds,
        year      = year_i
      )
      
      all_importance[[as.character(year_i)]] <- data.frame(
        variable   = rownames(importance(model)),
        importance = importance(model, type = 1)[, 1],
        year       = year_i
      )
    }
    
    results <- bind_rows(all_preds)
    
    if (nrow(results) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    rmse     <- sqrt(mean((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2))
    rsq      <- cor(results$Observed, results$Predicted)^2
    mean_obs <- mean(results$Observed)
    nse      <- 1 - sum((results$Observed - results$Predicted)^2) /
                     sum((results$Observed - mean_obs)^2)
    
    importance_df <- bind_rows(all_importance) %>%
      group_by(variable) %>%
      summarise(importance = mean(importance), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(model = label, site = site_name)
    
    list(
      metrics     = data.frame(site = site_name, model = label,
                               RMSE = rmse, R2 = rsq, NSE = nse),
      importance  = importance_df,
      predictions = results %>% mutate(site = site_name, model = label)
    )
  }
  
  with_vpd    <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_with,    "with_VPD")
  without_vpd <- fit_rf_loyo(predictors_without, "without_VPD")
  
  if (is.null(with_vpd) || is.null(without_vpd)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    site        = site_name,
    metrics     = bind_rows(with_vpd$metrics,     without_vpd$metrics),
    importance  = bind_rows(with_vpd$importance,  without_vpd$importance),
    predictions = bind_rows(with_vpd$predictions, without_vpd$predictions)
  )
}

# ── Run model ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rf_results_vpd <- purrr::map2(
  sites_daily,
  names(sites_daily),
  run_rf_with_without_vpd
)

all_metrics_vpd <- purrr::map_df(rf_results_vpd, ~ .x$metrics)
```

```{r}
  left_join(n_years_df, by = "site")

# ── Prepare plot data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  select(site, R2) %>%
  left_join(
    site_meta %>% select(site, MAP, MAT, MAL, n_years.x),
    by = "site"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MAP, MAT, MAL),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

```

```{r}

# ── Plot 1: ΔR² from adding VPD ───────────────────────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  mutate(
    site    = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order),
    R2_gain = with_VPD - without_VPD
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2_gain)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "ΔR² from adding VPD",
    y     = "ΔR² (with − without)",
    x     = "Sites (Wet to Dry)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Plot 2: R² with VPD — wet to dry order ────────────────────────────────────
all_metrics_vpd %>%
  filter(model == "with_VPD") %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Model R² (with VPD) — predictors: Tair, SW_rad, VPD, CWD_7day, LAI",
    y     = "R²",
    x     = "Sites (Wet to Dry)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

# ── Plot 3: MAP, MAT, MAL vs R² ───────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggrepel)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, y = R2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "loess",
    span    = 1.0,       # controls smoothness — higher = smoother curve
                         # with only ~20 sites keep this high to avoid overfitting
    se      = TRUE,      # shaded confidence interval
    colour  = "grey40",
    fill    = "grey70",
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = site), size = 2.8, colour = "grey30",
                  max.overlaps = 15) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3,
             labeller = labeller(variable = c(
               MAP = "MAP (mm yr⁻¹)",
               MAT = "MAT (°C)",
               MAL = "MAL (m² m⁻²)"
             ))) +
  labs(y = "R² (RF with VPD)", x = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA)
  )

# ── Plot 4: Number of years vs R² ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(plot_data %>% distinct(site, R2, n_years.x), aes(x = n_years.x, y = R2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = thesis_cols["main"]) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey40",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = site), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  labs(x = "No. of Years of Observations", y = "R²") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Summary metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
metrics_wide <- all_metrics_vpd %>%
  select(site, model, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = R2) %>%
  rename(
    R2_with_VPD    = with_VPD,
    R2_without_VPD = without_VPD
  ) %>%
  mutate(delta_R2 = R2_with_VPD - R2_without_VPD)

summary(metrics_wide)
```
